description: This file declares classes and interfaces for managing multicast DNS (mDNS) connections, sockets, and client operations within the Chromium project. It includes definitions for socket factories, connection handling, cache management, and transaction handling related to mDNS.

classes.name: MDnsSocketFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements socket creation for mDNS using provided network log.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages network connection for multicast DNS, handles socket communication, and delegates packet handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Main implementation of the MDnsClient interface, manages listeners, cache, and network connection.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of MDnsListener, manages active listening and record refreshes.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Implements MDnsTransaction, manages sending queries, handling responses, and transaction lifecycle.

classes.name: Core
classes.description: Inner class of MDnsClientImpl, maintains cache, listeners, and network connection, and handles core mDNS operations.

classes.name: MDnsConnection::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for handling received mDNS packets and connection errors.

classes.name: MDnsConnection::SocketHandler
classes.description: Handles individual socket communication for MDnsConnection.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates and initializes UDP sockets for mDNS communication.

methods.name: HandlePacket
methods.description: Processes incoming DNS responses and delegates handling.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data over the network via UDP socket.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the mDNS connection with socket factory.

methods.name: CreateListener
methods.description: Creates a new mDNS listener for specified record type and name.

methods.name: CreateTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new mDNS transaction for querying records.

methods.name: IsListening
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently listening.
